duration.description: A whole number above zero and a unit: s, m, h or d.

host.description: A host of a systemHealth widget. It needs url or source.

interval.description: How often a url host is polled while the dashboard is shown.

key.description: Shortcut letter, a to z; p and i are reserved. Default: the first free letter of the name.

name.description: Display name. Required, except for a local host, which is named after this machine.

source.description: local: this machine, read in-process. Any other value names a source whose JSON is a foyer /api/health payload.

item.description: A labelled value of a keyValueList. It needs pick or picks.

format.description: int (alias integer): a whole number. decimal (alias %.2f): two decimals. Absent: as is.

match.description: When the source's JSON is a list, use the first element whose fields equal all of these values.

pick.description: Path of the one value to show: field names separated by dots (the leading dot is optional) and [N] indexes. A legacy path, never jq.

picks.description: Paths of two values, shown as buy / sell.

source.description: Where to pick from. Default: the widget's source.

layer.description: A platform block: any top-level key except platform.

hotkey.description: Built-in toggle hotkey: f1-f20, letters, digits, space, escape, home or end, with cmd (super), ctrl, alt (opt) and shift, joined with +. Letters, digits, space and escape need cmd, ctrl or alt. null registers nothing; bind `vestal toggle` in the window manager instead.

sources.description: Named data sources. Widgets refer to them by name; every widget reading one shares its fetch. null deletes a built-in one.

views.description: Named views. The dashboard shows main.

widgets.description: Named widgets. A widget shows when a view's order lists its key. null deletes a built-in one.

picks.description: Paths of a buy and a sell value (legacy paths, never jq).

platform.description: Per-OS blocks. Each takes any top-level key except platform.

linux.description: Merged over the rest of the file on Linux.

macos.description: Merged over the rest of the file on macOS.

privacy.description: The system bar's privacy toggle. It shows, and its p key works, only when both keys are set.

command.description: Run to toggle privacy mode, with the rules of a command source's argv.

stateFile.description: The file that exists while privacy mode is on. A leading ~/ expands.

source.description: A source: an object whose type picks the keys it takes.

calendars.description: Only calendars with these names. Default: all.

days.description: How many days to read, today being the first.

type.description: The source type; eventkit is an alias.

source.command.description: Runs a program, never through a shell.

argv.description: The program and its arguments. argv[0] is looked up on PATH and the usual Nix and Homebrew directories. A leading ~ or ~/ in any element expands to the home directory.

parse.description: json: stdout must be valid JSON. raw: stdout as it is.

timeout.description: The command is killed after this long.

source.http.description: Fetches a URL with a 10 second timeout.

parse.description: json: the body must be valid JSON. raw: the body as it is.

url.description: An http:// or https:// URL. The answer must have a 2xx status.

source.override.description: Changes to a source of the same name in a lower layer (the built-in defaults): any of its keys, without type.

path.description: Claude Code's projects directory. A leading ~/ expands.

weeklyLimit.description: Tokens that count as 100% over 7 days.

worldClocks.description: Extra clocks under the date. A clock in the local time zone is skipped.
